**Research notes: TSX, Monday, Oct 12, 2026**

**Today:** The TSX is not trading today. TMX Group said the Toronto Stock Exchange, TSX Venture Exchange, TSX Alpha Exchange and Montréal Exchange are closed Monday, October 12, 2026 for the Thanksgiving holiday. The TMX release is dated October 5, 2026. Regular trading resumes Tuesday, October 13. US markets are open today. That means there is no live TSX movement to report for today.

**Last session (Friday, Oct 9, 2026):**
- The S&P/TSX composite index was up 519.24 points at 35,664.62 (BNN Bloomberg/Canadian Press). That is a gain of about 1.48%. TMX Money and Yahoo Finance show the same close.
- BNN Bloomberg described the rise as closing out a volatile week, with investors focused on bond yields and the health of the Canadian economy.
- Trading Economics attributed the gain to weaker employment data reinforcing expectations that the Bank of Canada will not hike rates. It said employment fell by 68,300 against an expected gain of 7,000. Another outlet, ad-hoc-news, gave the figure as an expected gain of 9,200.
- At midday, gold and materials each rose 2.7% and information technology rose 2.1% (Baystreet, via ad-hoc-news).
- The 52-week range is 29,530.90 to 37,069.10.
- The index was up 0.45% over the past month and 19.48% over the past year (Trading Economics).

**Discrepancy:** One source, ad-hoc-news, gave the Oct 9 close as 35,587, up 1.3%. TMX, Yahoo Finance, Investing.com, BNN Bloomberg and Trading Economics all show 35,664.62. The 35,587 figure looks like an earlier intraday or preliminary number.

**US markets Oct 9 (BNN Bloomberg):** The Dow was up 423.31 points at 51,654.95. The S&P 500 was up 46.18 points at 7,811.54. The Nasdaq was up 172.83 points at 27,366.17.
